subject: Biology
title: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants - DPP 04 (Embryo Sac & Sporangium)

questions.question: During development of embryo sac in angiosperm plant, polar nuclei located -
options: In large central cell above the egg apparatus
questions.explanation: Option (C) is correct: Below the egg apparatus.

questions.question: Select the mismatched pair.
questions.explanation: Option (C) is correct: Pollen grain - Integument.

questions.question: Read the following statements and mark the right option A. In angiosperm, each ovule always have only two protective layers known as integument B. The synergids have special cellular thickenings at the micropylar tip called filliform apparatus C. Nucleus of functional megaspore divide mitotically
options: Only B and C are correct
Only A and C are correct
All A, B and C are correct
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Only B and C are correct.

questions.question: From among the sets of terms given below, identify those that are associated with the gynoecium.
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: Stigma, ovule, embryo sac, placenta.

questions.question: Match the following columns. Choose the correct answer from the options given below.
questions.explanation: Option (C) is correct: A-(r), B-(s), C-(p), D-(q).

questions.question: In the following figure, label the parts A, B, C, D, E
options: Hilum, Funicle, inner integument, nucellus, micropyle
Funicle, micropyle, inner integument, nucellus, chalazal pole
Hilum, Funicle integument, Embryo sac, chalazal pole
Funicle, Hilum, integument, Embryo sac, Micropylar pole
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Funicle, micropyle, inner integument, nucellus, chalazal pole.

questions.question: Which part of ovule stores abundant food reserves?
Nucellus is
options: Poorly developed in all flowering plants
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Parenchymatous mass of tissue.

questions.question: An ovule generally has ......... embryo sac formed from a megaspore through ........... division
A typical angiosperm embryo sac at maturity is:
Largest cell of the ovule is
Match column I with column II: Choose the correct option from the codes given below
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: A-III, B-II, C-IV, D-I.

questions.question: Which of the following is a direct structure formed by a functional megaspore?
Monosporic development in angiosperms implies
options: Out of four microspores only one microspore is functional
Out of four megaspores only one megaspore is functional and undergo meiosis
Out of four megaspores only one megaspore is functional and undergo mitosis.
questions.explanation: Option (D) is correct: Out of four megaspores only one megaspore is functional and undergo mitosis..

questions.question: Identify the incorrect statement related to Pollination:
options: Moths and butterflies are the most dominant pollinating agents among insects
Pollination by water is quite rare in flowering plants
Pollination by wind is more common amongst abiotic pollination
Flowers produce foul odours to attract flies and beetles to get pollinated
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: Moths and butterflies are the most dominant pollinating agents among insects.

questions.question: The number of cells present in the egg apparatus in angiosperms is
Given below is the diagrammatic view of an embryo sac. Identify the labelled parts , and select the right option.
A, B, C, D
options: Synergids, Central cell, Egg cell, Antipodals, Polar nuclei
Antipodals, Polar nuclei, Egg cell, Synergids, Filiform apparatus
Polar nuclei, Antipodals, Egg cell, Synergids, Filiform apparatus
Antipodals, Central cell, Egg cell, Synergids, Filiform apparatus
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Antipodals, Polar nuclei, Egg cell, Synergids, Filiform apparatus.
